items.period: Western Zhou bronze-script style; the specific inscription and date of the depicted form are unverified.
items.tradition: Western Zhou bronze-script style; modern vector redraw, not a photograph of a bronze inscription.
items.caption: This modern redraw shows 水 in a bronze-script style, with a winding central stroke and separate side marks. Bronze forms are described as retaining the flowing-water picture, though this image does not establish the exact inscription it reproduces.
items.alt: Black glyph with a winding central stroke and four separate side marks, two on each side.
items.selection_reason: The visible central stroke and side marks make a useful comparison for the account of 水 as flowing water with droplets. The particular inscription behind this redraw is unverified.
items.rights: Public domain for the vector representation, as stated on the exact Commons file page.

limitations.text: The drawing is identified as Western Zhou bronze-script style, but its exact inscriptional source is unverified. The early Western Zhou date applies to the named vessel, not necessarily to this particular glyph.
